title: Vegan Aubergine Kebab
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan kebab dish made with marinated aubergine, served with a side of quick fix sauce.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: you can use other vegan oil alternatives

instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cut the aubergine into kebab-sized pieces.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the aubergine pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the aubergine for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
Serve the aubergine kebab with quick fix sauce on the side.
